none: PAS SUSS-4E1267: Coin of Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: West Sussex (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete copper alloy Roman nummus of Constantine I (306-337 AD). Mint: Trier, dating to 313-315 AD. Obverse depicts a laureate and cuirassed bust facing right; the legend reads: CONSTANTINVS PF AVG. The reverse depicts Sol standing left, raising right hand, globe in left, with chlamys across left shoulder; the reverse legend reads: SOLI INVIC-TO COMITI. Reece Period: 15. Cf. RIC VII, p 168,…
